description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the RustAdapter plugin in the WPEFramework, including configuration, lifecycle management, and method declarations.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing the Rust::IPlugin interface, managing plugin lifecycle, configuration, and communication.

classes.name: RustAdapter::Config
classes.description: Configuration container class for the RustAdapter plugin, holding settings like out-of-process flag, address, port, autoexec, and libname.

methods.name: ~RustAdapter()
methods.description: Default destructor for the RustAdapter class.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell interface.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin (conditional compilation based on version).

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the plugin (conditional compilation based on version).

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a channel (conditional compilation based on version).

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes a callback (conditional compilation based on version).

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token, method, and parameters (conditional compilation based on version).

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC invocation (conditional compilation based on context and version).

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Static method to get library path or name based on inputs.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Static method to retrieve authentication token.
